messages:
Priya (CSM): Quick heads-up — StripeHealth QBR scheduled Tue 10am ET. Need final deck, one-slide exec asks, and a demo owner. Can we lock owners today?
Sam (Lead CSM): I'm around. I'll own the renewal ask slide if no objections.
Ari (Solutions Eng): I can assemble the tech / performance slides. Will pull latest latency + cost numbers.
Jon (Product): Please include the model-swap impact metric (avg inference latency delta last 30d). That's the concern execs will ask about.
Priya (CSM): Good — include: 1) account health score, 2) onboarding status w/ blockers, 3) renewal risk heatmap, 4) demo choreography + owner, 5) action-item list with owners and due dates.
Elena (Enablement): I can own the demo script and rehearse with the AE. Who's demo owner? @Ari? :raised_hands:
Ari (Solutions Eng): I can be demo owner if Maya can prep the environment and a short test dataset.
Maya (Eng): Yep — I can prod a small canary environment and share a reproducible run. Quick query I'll paste into the slide notes:```sql
-- 30d avg latency per model
SELECT model_name, AVG(latency_ms) as avg_ms
FROM inference_metrics
WHERE ts > now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY model_name
ORDER BY avg_ms DESC;
```
Sam (Lead CSM): Nice. For the renewal risk heatmap, I'm planning a simple 3x3: usage trend (up/flat/down) vs exec engagement (high/med/low). I'll drop a draft slide by EOD. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Priya (CSM): Action items: Sam -> heatmap slide (EOD), Ari -> perf + demo slide (EOD), Maya -> canary env + runbook (tomorrow noon), Elena -> demo script + AE rehearsal times (tomorrow 3pm), Jon -> confirm any product asks to surface to execs (EOD). I'll own the exec ask one-pager.
sync-bot: Reminder set — StripeHealth QBR Tue 10:00 ET (channel reminder).
Jon (Product): One more ask — can we include a single customer quote about value realized? Even a short bullet helps. Sam, can you pull one?
Sam (Lead CSM): On it. I'll grab a quote from the onboarding survey and paste into the deck.
Priya (CSM): Great. If we can get slides in #drive/shared/qbr/stripehealth by COB today I'll do a quick pass tonight. If anything blocks ownership ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Ari (Solutions Eng): Uploading a placeholder deck now with slide stubs. Will annotate where I need numbers.
Maya (Eng): Posting canary run results to the folder by 11:30.
Elena (Enablement): Adding rehearsal invite for Mon 4pm ET.
Priya (CSM): Thanks team — will consolidate and send the exec one-pager after Sam's heatmap and Ari's perf slide land.
Sam (Lead CSM): If anyone sees a serious renewal flag (usage < threshold + low exec engagement) call it out here so we can escalate to AE and Rev Ops.
Priya (CSM): Noted. Will highlight any red flags in the one-pager.
Ari (Solutions Eng): Quick note for slides: include the mitigation playbook (fallback model, cache warmup, routing policy) under reliability section. Execs like clear remediation steps.
Priya (CSM): Perfect. That's the narrative I want. End-of-thread for now — will reopen if something changes.
